nodes.title: CORE - START HERE
widgets_values:
SEAMLESS CHAIN - CORE (v2.6.1)

The simple version: no extra packs, no options. Type shots, press Run,
get one joined video with sound.

Defaults fit 16-24 GB cards. More VRAM? Raise the size in the controls.

Guides:
5-minute guide  https://civitai.com/articles/34047/make-talking-videos-with-minimax-h3-the-5-minute-guide-26
Every setting explained  https://civitai.com/articles/34046/every-setting-explained-the-seamless-chain-deep-manual

Modded note: exact_audio path added with audio lock for external audio that has to be used rather than just reference audio.
Latent out (video and combine AV) for external processing such as upscaling.
Toggle to output the last full length shot regardless of whether the audio ends early. Any extra video will have audio silence.
Integrated H3 Longform VAE decoder. This custom node chunks the output latent to save on VRAM allowing long video output on low VRAM GPU's. Do not adjust the number (default 14) unless you have a low VRAM GPU. Lower means smaller VRAM. Tested at 14 on a 16GB GPU.

nodes.title: LoRA stack (inert until a slot is set)
SAMPLER
widgets_values:
YOUR SCRIPT

One paragraph per shot. Put --- on its own line between shots.
3 paragraphs = 3 shots = one continuous video.

Keep spoken lines to about 8-12 words per shot, wrapped like this:
<d>[English] Your line here.</d>

Describe the place the same way, word for word, in every shot.

nodes.title: MASTER AUDIO — one full song / dialogue track
SEAMLESS CHAIN SAMPLER (core)

h3_widget_values.script:
Establish the subject, setting, lighting, and camera language. If using a reference image, preserve its identity, wardrobe, proportions, and color palette. Describe the opening action clearly. She danced sensually.
---
Continue exactly from the previous shot's final frame. Keep the same subject and environment; advance the action naturally with no reset, hard cut, morphing, or new scenery. She dances energetically.
---
Continue seamlessly from the prior final frame. Vary the camera or action only when motivated, while preserving identity, lighting, and background continuity. She sweeps her right arm across the frame as if pointing at an audience.
---
Continue from the previous final frame and resolve the scene with a clear final action or held pose. No text, logos, subtitles, or watermarks unless explicitly requested.
